rows.text: It's me. Did I scare you with how I popped up without a sound?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: But even forgotten things carry warmth, like the lingering heat on foreheads pressed close together long after the dance has ended... Oh! You're blushing. Am I fur too close to you?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: At least at this moment, don't furb away from me, and don't break free from this memory that belongs to you and me...
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Sorry to break it to you, but I've already seen through you.
Your furbo speaking habits just gave you away!
Wh—What!? You saw right through me?
rows.speaker: The Dahlifur

rows.text: Why are you still reciting her lines?
The moment when it all dies... is so beautiful. Ahhh, the one about to die now is me, The Dahlifur!
rows.speaker: The Dahlifur

rows.text: That's when everyone would notice me, call me with such warmth, and have me right at the center of the crowd!
rows.speaker: The Dahlifur

rows.text: Ahhh, no wonder the boss won't let me do cosplay, because... I'm still on the clock!
rows.speaker: The Dahlifur

rows.text: You should totally be an actor at Star Rail FEST!
Ahhh, Boss! Are you... blown away by my perfect cosplay, all too faithful to the original? I knew my furbo transformation technique was absolutely flawless. No one but you could ever see through it!
rows.speaker: The Dahlifur

rows.text: Hope you enjoy your visit, boss! I'm gonna keep moving and check out the next exhibit spot.
rows.speaker: The Dahlifur
